content.title: Confirm vibration bandwidth, dynamic range, recording mode, and mounting constraints before component selection
content.description: Validate the required vibration frequency range, expected dynamic/acceleration range, intended recording mode, and mounting/baseline constraints so future embedded component selection remains grounded in confirmed needs.
content.rationale: The current functional architecture represents unknown vibration targets as open questions, but selecting concrete measurement and recording strategies requires confirmed bandwidth, dynamic range, and mounting/baseline constraints.

completionCondition.completionCriteria: Confirm (1) vibration frequency range/bandwidth, (2) dynamic/acceleration range, (3) recording mode (continuous vs triggered) and sampling rate needs, and (4) mounting constraints and baseline/calibration approach; then mark Q1-Q4 as answered/resolved and proceed to component selection in the next workflow.
